action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
I have a hat that talks to you,
With silly voices, loud and new!
It says "Good morning" when you wake,
And tells a joke before you take
A bite of toast or sip of tea,
The funniest hat you've ever seen!

***

It sings a song when you are sad,
About a dancing, happy tad.
It whispers secrets in your ear,
About a dragon made of cheese.
It never gets a single cold,
Or tells a story that is old.

***

If you are hungry, guess what?
The hat will make a tasty snack!
It pulls a cookie from its side,
Or makes a sandwich, nice and wide.
No more waiting for Mom or Dad,
The hat is here to help you eat!

***

It changes colors when you jump,
From purple to a neon bump.
It turns to green if you are scared,
Or blue if you are filled with air.
It's magic, real, and not a lie,
Underneath the open sky.

***

So come and buy this special thing,
The best hat that the world can bring!
It's not just fabric, it's a friend,
Who never stops until the end.
Put it on your head right now,
And watch the magic start to grow!

***

Don't wait too long to get your own,
Before the stock is all gone down!
The talking hat is waiting here,
To make your boring days disappear.
So grab a hat and start to play,
And have a wonderful, funny day!
action.label: response
